2608.10678.title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
2608.10678.paper_summary: Chinese web pollution has surfaced in LLMs, motivating audits of upstream Chinese corpora. However, auditing such corpora faces three challenges: (1) their web-scale size makes full scan costly; (2) prior analyses are often too coarse to expose token-level pollution; (3) Chinese web pollution is implicit and rapidly changing. We propose Sampled-BPE, a lightweight token-level auditing pipeline that sample a small subset and train BPE tokenizer to surface polluted tokens. Experiments show that Sampled-BPE preserves usable estimates while substantially reducing runtime and memory: a 148.4 $\times$ speedup and a 35.8 $\times$ memory reduction induce only 4.25% relative error for pollution categories. We apply the pipeline to 11 open Chinese corpora and 6 Chinese Common Crawl snapshots from 2021 to 2026. The audit reveals widespread but uneven pollution across open corpora, as well as highly polluted and temporally shifting Chinese web content. We further release a hierarchical Chinese web token dataset with 660k+ token records, each with web context, category, and explanation fields, organized as trees to support review and tracing of pollution.
2608.10678.paper_summary_zh: 中國網路污染已在大型語言模型（LLMs）中顯現，促使對上游中國語料庫的審計。然而，審計這些語料庫面臨三個挑戰： (1) 它們的網路規模使得全面掃描成本高昂； (2) 先前的分析通常過於粗略，無法揭示字元級的污染； (3) 中國網路污染是隱性且迅速變化的。我們提出了Sampled-BPE，一個輕量級的字元級審計管道，通過抽樣小子集並訓練BPE分詞器來揭示受污染的字元。實驗表明，Sampled-BPE保留了可用的估算，同時大幅減少了運行時間和內存：148.4倍的加速和35.8倍的內存減少僅引入了4.25%的相對誤差於污染類別。我們將該管道應用於11個開放的中國語料庫和6個2021年至2026年的中國Common Crawl快照。審計顯示開放語料庫中存在廣泛但不均勻的污染，以及高度污染且隨時間變化的中國網路內容。我們進一步發布了一個層次化的中國網路字元數據集，擁有超過660k的字元記錄，每個記錄都包含網路上下文、類別和解釋字段，組織為樹狀結構以支持污染的審查和追蹤。
